commands: git fetch origin main && git reset --hard origin/main >/dev/null && test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "fff9d3a8c024ca19dcf6fc39619c2b7559a546ac" && test -z "$(git status --porcelain)" && echo EXACT_SHA_OK

printf '%s\n' '=== LARGEST SOURCE FILES (LINES) ==='; git ls-files 'src/*' 'lib/*' 'tools/*' 'test/*' 'tests/*' | grep -E '\.(c|cc|cpp|h|hpp|py)$' | while read -r f; do test -f "$f" && printf '%8d %s\n' "$(wc -l < "$f")" "$f"; done | sort -nr | head -n 80

printf '%s\n' '=== RTOS/TIMING HOTSPOTS ==='; grep -RInE 'xTaskCreate|xTaskCreatePinnedToCore|xQueueCreate|xSemaphoreCreate|vTaskDelay|vTaskDelayUntil|pdMS_TO_TICKS|uxTaskGetStackHighWaterMark' src 2>/dev/null | head -n 1000 || true
printf '%s\n' '=== TODO/FIXME/HACK/XXX ==='; grep -RInE 'TODO|FIXME|HACK|XXX' src lib tools test tests docs 2>/dev/null | head -n 500 || true
